definitions.KEEP_R08: pre-P11 full R08 ordering captured from the served pipeline
definitions.KEEP_P11: served P11-active ordering; exact R08 Top10 membership and tail preserved
definitions.CANDIDATE_RERANK: new frozen P12-v1 diagnostic: full C50 structured rerank using current target-blind scorer plus visible numeric budget
definitions.FROZEN_SEMANTIC_RERANK: new frozen P12-v1 diagnostic: BGE cosine computed only inside C50 and blended with the sparse rank prior
definitions.RESULT_AWARE_REWRITE_RETRIEVE: existing P5 R01 guarded PRF action based on R08, not a P11 composition
definitions.COMPACT_NEGATIVE_C50: P11-based C50 stable compatible-unknown-explicit-violation partition using only current-version hard excluded-term negatives and catalog-only compact masks
definitions.GUARDED_COMPACT_SLOT10: single P11 rank-10 admission: replace a compact unknown or explicit violation only with the first rank-11-to-50 challenger in a strictly better compatibility class while preserving ranks 1-to-9
definitions.GUARDED_COMPACT_SLOT10_STRICT: adjacent P11 rank-10 admission: only swap an explicit-violation rank 10 with a compatible rank 11 while preserving ranks 1-to-9 and ranks 12-to-50
definitions.P11_EVIDENCE_NOVEL_SLOT10: single P11 rank-10 admission from P11 ranks 11-to-50, excluding structured and semantic Top10 candidates; require evidence delta at least 0.12, relevance delta at least 0.04, runner-up evidence gap at least 0.03, and at least two frozen signal groups
definitions.HARD_CLAUSE_NOVEL_SLOT10: single P11 rank-10 admission from P11 ranks 11-to-50, excluding structured and semantic Top10 candidates; require at least four hard-clause terms, challenger coverage at least 0.85, incumbent coverage at most 0.40, and runner-up gap at least 0.25
definitions.TWO_SIGNAL_CONSENSUS_NOVEL_SLOT10: single P11 rank-10 admission from P11 ranks 11-to-50, excluding structured and semantic Top10 candidates; require the unique lexical and constraint argmax to be the same challenger with frozen incumbent and runner-up margins
definitions.ASK: observed served fast-policy continuation with KEEP_P11 recommendations; not an independent counterfactual

actions.ask_semantics: observed KEEP_P11 recommendations plus the served fast-policy continuation; not an independent counterfactual and cannot unlock CAGE-R10

family2_novel_slot10.selection_order: primary score descending with original P11 rank as the stable secondary order
family2_novel_slot10.selection_policy: select the leading safe-novel challenger and runner-up before guards; never scan down after a failed guard
family2_novel_slot10.output_policy: swap P11 indices 9 and challenger_original_index in the full C50; Top1-to-9 remain exact and Top10 symmetric difference is exactly two

actions.fixed_weights_status: preregistered P12-v1 diagnostic weights; not prior production evidence

evaluation.trajectory: complete ten-turn replay driven only by served KEEP_P11 ask_attribute; never target-stopped
evaluation.label_join: only after worker close, clean exit, and trace SHA-256 verification
